panel.title: Characterizations
panel.description: Measurements done on this sample, with their raw files.
panel.empty: No characterizations yet. Record the first one, for example SEM or EDX.

form.description: Record that a measurement was done on this sample. The same technique can be recorded more than once.
form.techniqueHint: For example SEM, EDX or ellipsometry. Use the names you already use.
form.noteHint: Optional. For example the area measured or the instrument settings.

delete.title: Delete {technique}?
delete.description: This removes the record of this measurement and the files attached to it. It cannot be undone.

files.dialogDescription: Files are copied into the app's storage, under this sample. Up to 50 MB each, any type.
files.dropHint: Any file type, up to 50 MB each
files.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file attached} other {# files attached}}
files.removeDescription: The file is deleted from storage. This cannot be undone.

errors.tooLarge: {name} is larger than 50 MB and was not attached.
